fields.why: The count of tests distributed (~440,000) is a headline result in the Summary and is judged against the program's expectation of 200,000; it is an event count reported as an outcome, not just a denominator, so count/rate applies.
The table notes state 'Gender identity is a composite of reported sex at birth and current gender identity'; under v5 that is SOGI (self-identified) plus sex (assigned or observed).
